summary: Freenome, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of a business combination with Perceptive Capital Solutions Corp (PCSC), a SPAC, on July 20, 2026. The transaction involved PCSC's domestication from Cayman Islands to Delaware, followed by a double reverse merger where Freenome merged into a PCSC subsidiary, with the surviving entity becoming a wholly-owned subsidiary of PCSC. Freenome shareholders received PCSC common stock. No specific price per share or premium was disclosed. The filing describes the structural steps: domestication, first merger of Merger Sub I with Freenome, then second merger of surviving Freenome into Merger Sub II. Watch for post-combination trading under ticker FRNM and any potential earnout or lockup provisions.
